title: Cloudflare新政策推动AI公司为出版商的内容付费
content: Cloudflare 要求 AI 公司在 9 月 15 日之前将用于搜索的网络爬虫与用于 AI 训练和代理的网络爬虫分开，否则可能会在许多发布商网站上被默认屏蔽。
original_title: Cloudflare’s new policy pushes AI companies to pay for publishers’ content
original_content: Cloudflare is giving AI companies until September 15 to separate web crawlers used for search from those used for AI training and agents, or risk being blocked by default on many publisher sites.
